data.narrative:
Breaker Industries is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $6M to date. The comparable universe comprises three same-sector peers at Seed and Series A stages—UFORCE ($1.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M)—alongside a broader set of 10 public and private defense-tech benchmarks including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier to the $6M total raised as a proxy base, implying a $15M valuation. Peer-median analysis yields a $400M valuation based on the median of the three same-sector comparables, with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B. The wide peer dispersion reflects heterogeneity in capital intensity, technology maturity, and customer traction within early-stage defense tech.

Triangulation across both methods supports a valuation range of $13M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $208M. The substantial spread between stage-progression and peer-median results reflects tension between capital-efficiency underwriting and market multiples in a venture-backed sector. Key uncertainties include the degree to which Breaker's unspecified technical differentiation warrants premium positioning within the peer set, and whether comparable valuations reflect genuine milestone progress or market momentum in defense-tech investing.
